summary_en: Flerovium is a superheavy artificial chemical element with symbol Fl and atomic number 114. It is an extremely radioactive synthetic element. The element is named after the Flerov Laboratory of Nuclear Reactions of the Joint Institute for Nuclear Research in Dubna, Russia, where the element was discovered in 1998.
summary_ko: Flerovium은(는) 후전이 금속 원소로, 교육·연구·산업에 활용되는 기본 소재다. 상온에서는 이며 안전 지침을 따라 다루는 것이 권장된다.
